text:
sam: quick Q — seeing a short spike of 503s for POST /v1/generate from eu-west1 around 11:12 UTC. Where do we keep saved logsearches that combine org+model+route filters? any dashboard I should jump to? :eyes:

ben: we have a couple. Start with the ops saved searches: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#/savedSearch/ops-eu-503-by-route. That one breaks down by route+status. For per-org+model you want ops/eu-503-by-org-model (see below).

sam: perfect — can you paste the exact query so I can filter to the affected org?

ben: use this KQL in Discover (set time to 15m around the spike):

```
org_id: "acct_92f" and http.request.path: "/v1/generate" and cloud.region: "eu-west1" and http.response.status_code: 503
```

Then add a split: terms(model_name.keyword, 10) to see top models. If you prefer a lucene-style: `org_id:\"acct_92f\" AND route:\"/v1/generate\" AND region:\"eu-west1\" AND status_code:503`.

ben: saved search name: `ops/eu-503-by-org-model` URL: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#/savedSearch/ops-eu-503-by-org-model — it includes the fields we use: org_id, model_name, route, region, status_code, latency_ms, node_id.

marta: fyi, if you find it’s concentrated on a single model variant, open traces in Jaeger (link below) and check KV-cache hits. Quick trace link pattern: https://tracing.redwood.internal/jaeger/search?service=inference&tags[route]=/v1/generate&lookback=15m

tracing-bot: note: sample trace id prefix for recent 503s -> 8a3f... (attached in Discover sample row).

sam: thanks — I ran the saved search and see ~14 503s in that 15m window, 12 of them for model `gpt-medium-2025-q4` and all from org acct_92f.

marta: sounds like we should tune the alert. Current alert `alerts/inference-route-5xx-p99` fires on 5xx ratio > 0.5% over 5m. For per-route incidents that small org-level blast can be noisy. Proposal: add a condition to the alert to only fire if either (a) total 5xx count > 20 in 5m OR (b) 5xx ratio > 0.5% AND affected orgs > 3. That will reduce chattiness for single-org bursts.

sam: I can open a PR for the alert rule change. Which file is that stored in infra config?

ben: alerts live in infra/monitoring/alerts.yml in the infra repo. Add a rule under `inference_route_errors` and include `group_by: [route, region]` and `filters: [status_code>=500]`. Ping me for review.

infra-bot: saved search `ops/eu-503-by-org-model` created/updated by ben at 1758700180. Link: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#/savedSearch/ops-eu-503-by-org-model :white_check_mark:

marta: also add a prescriptive dashboard panel: 1) 503 count by org (top 10), 2) 503 count by model, 3) latency p95 for route. If you want I can add the dashboard and pin the saved search.

sam: please, that would help. Also, do we have a quick playbook snippet for "single-org 503 spike"?

ben: yes — playbook lives in docs/runbooks/observability/inference-503.md. Steps 1-5: confirm via saved search, check traces, check host GPU mem & kv cache eviction logs, check recent deployments for that model, and if confirmed, throttle model variant at routing layer (route policy).

sam: opening PR to update alert rule and linking the runbook + saved search. Will ping when ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

marta: cheers — if you want me to own the dashboard I can.

sam: that'd be great, assign it to marta. Closing the loop once PR merges.

ben: FYI: quick query you can paste in Console to list recent status distribution by region for that route: 

```
POST /_search
{ "size": 0, "query": { "bool": { "filter": [ { "term": { "http.request.path": "/v1/generate" } }, { "term": { "org_id": "acct_92f" } }, { "range": { "@timestamp": { "gte": "now-30m" } } } ] } }, "aggs": { "by_region": { "terms": { "field": "cloud.region.keyword" }, "aggs": { "status": { "terms": { "field": "http.response.status_code" } } } } } }
```

sam: excellent, I got what I needed. will follow up after PR.
